I have been farming in Mtwara for many years, and I know this land well. Groundnuts do not need chemical fertilizer because they put nitrogen back into the soil themselves, but I will spread manure from my cattle to keep the plot fertile. I will plant my own saved seed as I have always done, and my family will do most of the weeding and harvesting, though I will hire a few laborers for the busy days at harvest. We depend on the rains here, so I will not irrigate this small plot.
